concept: Review and integration: what being part of a community feels like so far
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Of fair rules, caring for shared spaces, and everyone's voice mattering — which feels most important to you?
exercise.practice: Student summarizes, in their own words, what 'citizenship' means so far

assessment.success_marker: student offers a personal definition connecting to at least one prior story
